scope: Actual unchanged published worker and three ordered HTTPS reads. Two facts commit before the third read is held. Deadline cancellation occurs with a renewed current lease; late release may not add effects. Published HTTP15 versus native HTTP20 remains a separate unresolved parity difference. This is not provider-I/O lease expiry, external signing, or aggregate worker cutover.
target_sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'config_version',config_version,'last_success_present',last_succeeded_at IS NOT NULL,'worker_id',metadata->'worker_id','worker_id_present',COALESCE(metadata::jsonb ? 'worker_id',false),'worker_heartbeat_present',COALESCE(metadata::jsonb ? 'worker_heartbeat_at',false)) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_targets WHERE id='target-review' AND organization_id='org-review'
job_age_sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'attempt_count',attempt_count,'started_at',started_at,'age_seconds',EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp()-started_at))) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_jobs WHERE id='worker-validation-job' AND organization_id='org-review'
effect_rows_sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('facts',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.evidence_facts f),'heads',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(h) ORDER BY application_id,logical_key) FROM issuance_service.evidence_fact_heads h),'reviews',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.evidence_policy_reviews r),'events',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.issuance_events e),'applications',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.applications a),'platforms',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.canvas_platforms p),'bindings',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.canvas_program_bindings b),'candidates',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.canvas_award_candidates c),'observations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.canvas_candidate_observations o))
operational_rows_sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('jobs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_jobs j),'targets',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY id) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_targets t))
